items.title: Israelisk general: Netanyahus stab försökte förfalska krigsprotokollet
items.summary: Benjamin Netanyahus medarbetare försökte ändra och redigera i protokoll och källmaterial efter Hamas terrorattack den 7 oktober 2023. Detta för att ställa premiärministerns insats den ödesdigra morgonen i mer fördelaktigt ljus.

items.title: Sweden participates in Steadfast Noon
items.summary: NATO’s annual exercise Steadfast Noon begins on October 13. Sweden is participating in the exercise with fighter aircraft (JAS 39 Gripen) and personnel from the Swedish Armed Forces.

items.title: Swedish air defence unit to NATO operations in Poland
items.summary: From December, Sweden intends to provide an air defence unit for the protection of NATO’s logistics hub in Poland used for military and civilian support to Ukraine.

items.title: Sweden to provide Gripen fighter jets for NATO operation in Poland
items.summary: As of October, Sweden will support the defence of NATO’s eastern flank in Poland with fighter jets. As part of the NATO operation, the fighter jets will contribute to NATO’s Integrated Air and Missile Defence and provide protection and security for military and civil support to Ukraine.

items.title: Sweden’s strategy for a peaceful, secure and sustainable Arctic
items.summary: The overarching and long-term objective of Sweden’s Arctic policy is a peaceful and secure Arctic, with sustainable, robust and attractive communities and reduced environmental and climate impact.
